name: LinkedIn
description: Read the authenticated user's LinkedIn feed and publish posts to their personal feed or a Company Page they administer.
_authNote: OAuth endpoints, scopes, client secret ref and the identity step are PLATFORM-OWNED — they live in the private clarity-api (integrations-v2/config/oauth-configs.ts), never in this public repo. This manifest only declares that LinkedIn uses oauth2 and which tools it provides.

providedTools.description: Fetch the most recent N posts from the authenticated user's home feed.

Publish a post to LinkedIn. Posts to the member's own feed by default; pass org_id to post as a Company Page the member administers (falls back to the personal feed if page posting isn't authorized). To publish a CHART with the post, bind `report.rows` to the structured data and the platform draws it as the post image; do not flatten a list into prose. Pass image_base64 instead when you already have the exact bytes (base64 PNG, no data: prefix). Describe either in image_alt.
List the LinkedIn Company Pages the authenticated member administers (for a page picker). Returns [] if Company Page access isn't authorized.

_localNote: Studio CANNOT broker this yet: no connector in packages/connectors. Calling any of these tools from an automation will fail at run time. See .claude/skills/add-an-integration/SKILL.md to request one.
